title: Comparing Things
ringkas: Comparative dan superlative: taller, the tallest, more beautiful
goals: membandingkan dua hal dengan **comparative**: [[taller than]], [[more beautiful than]]
menyebut yang paling dengan **superlative**: [[the tallest]], [[the most expensive]]
mengenal bentuk tidak beraturan: [[better]], [[the best]], [[worse]], [[the worst]]
membuat kalimat membandingkan orang, hewan, benda, dan tempat

lesson.text: Siapa yang **lebih tinggi**, kamu atau temanmu? Hewan apa yang **paling cepat**? Untuk menjawabnya kita memakai **comparative** (lebih) dan **superlative** (paling). Itulah topik **Unit 3**.

lesson.title: 1. Tiga tingkat kata sifat
lesson.text: Satu kata sifat punya tiga tingkat:
table: [[Budi is the tallest in the class.]]

lesson.title: 2. Kata sifat pendek (satu suku kata): -er dan -est
3. Kata sifat panjang (dua suku kata atau lebih): more dan most
Jangan dobel
lesson.text: Pilih **salah satu**: -er **atau** more. Salah: *more taller* atau *more beautifuler*. Benar: [[taller]] dan [[more beautiful]].

lesson.title: 5. Kalimat membandingkan
table: [[A cheetah is faster than a lion.]]
[[An elephant is the biggest land animal.]]
[[My bag is not as heavy as yours.]]

lesson.title: Than dan the
lesson.text: Comparative selalu diikuti **than** (daripada). Superlative selalu didahului **the**: [[the tallest]], [[the most expensive]].

read.id:
Gunung Bromo tingginya 2.329 meter. Gunung Semeru lebih tinggi, yaitu 3.676 meter. Itu gunung tertinggi di Jawa.
Gunung Merapi tingginya 2.930 meter, jadi lebih rendah dari Semeru tetapi lebih tinggi dari Bromo. Bromo paling mudah didaki, jadi lebih populer di kalangan wisatawan.

options: It is the easiest to climb.
It is the highest and the most dangerous.
It is the cheapest and closest to the city.
It is the oldest in all of Java.
qs.q: Why is Bromo popular with tourists?

read.text:
Mount Bromo is 2,329 meters high. Mount Semeru is higher, at 3,676 meters. It is the highest mountain in Java.
Mount Merapi is 2,930 meters high, so it is lower than Semeru but higher than Bromo. Bromo is the easiest to climb, so it is more popular with tourists.
read.title: Three Mountains

Rani ingin ponsel baru. Ponsel A harganya dua juta rupiah. Ponsel itu lebih kecil dan lebih ringan, dan baterainya tahan satu hari.
Ponsel B harganya tiga juta rupiah. Ponsel itu lebih besar dan lebih berat, tetapi kameranya lebih bagus dan baterainya lebih kuat. Rani berpikir Ponsel B lebih mahal, tetapi pilihan yang lebih baik untuk memotret.

qs.q: Why is Phone B a better choice for photos?

read.text:
Rani wants a new phone. Phone A costs two million rupiah. It is smaller and lighter, and the battery lasts for one day.
Phone B costs three million rupiah. It is bigger and heavier, but its camera is better and its battery is stronger. Rani thinks Phone B is more expensive, but it is a better choice for taking photos.
read.title: Two Phones
